intro.text: High priest of the god Stillmark, who argues in the Court of Gods against going to war with Idris.
High priest of the god Stillmark and the Court of Gods' most outspoken opponent of war with Idris, though for a time he was forced to change sides.

items.text: When the Court of Gods debated war with Idris, Nanrovah argued against it, opposed by Blushweaver's high priestess, Inhanna.
As a distraction in one of their schemes, Denth's mercenaries had their Lifeless club the horse pulling Nanrovah's carriage, scattering his gold across the street.

Nanrovah then suddenly began backing the war. Vasher and Vivenna found out why: the attack on his carriage had covered the kidnapping of his young daughter, held captive to silence him. They rescued her and brought her home to her grateful father.
Free to speak his mind again, he went back to arguing against war, but having changed his position twice, he found few willing to listen.

appearance.text: He wears priest's robes in his god's colours, blue and gold.

personality.text: A traditionalist like his god, he argues against most proposals put to the Court and is widely respected. He inherited a fortune from his father, one of Hallandren's richest merchants, so his vote can't be bought.
